title: Frontend Surface Read-only Verification and Governed Refresh Delegation

phases.objective: Keep pull-request Frontend verification strictly read-only while publishing exact run-bound structured evidence that a trusted workflow_run dispatcher can use to delegate an explicitly authorized exact-head refresh to the registered workflow_dispatch-only writer.

e2e_journeys.actor: Pull-request verifier and trusted repository automation
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A Frontend-affecting pull request runs Frontend surface dispatch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Verification publishes independently attributable exact-candidate evidence without repository writes; only a committed-generated-parity failure may be delegated by the trusted dispatcher to the protected-branch-safe expected-head writer.
steps: Generate Frontend and OpenAPI evidence from the canonical default-branch baseline without short-circuiting structured reporting.
Execute the seven Frontend generator and OpenAPI contract checks independently.
Publish the run-bound generator summary and mad4b.frontend-dispatch-verification-evidence.v1 before enforcing the final decision.
Bind candidate kind and SHA, source head SHA, head ref, base ref, stage outcomes, and first failure without consulting Job logs.
Reject contents-write permission, direct git push, protected-branch mutation, force push, and in-band generated-evidence commits.
Allow the trusted workflow_run dispatcher to consume only the exact run-bound source Artifact.
Permit delegation only when committed_generated_parity is the first failure and the exact pull request carries explicit refresh authorization.
Pass the exact expected head SHA to governed-generated-artifact-refresh.yml, which remains the only repository writer.
assertions: Frontend surface dispatch has contents read permission and no contents write permission.
The pull-request workflow contains no git push and no refresh-generated writer job.
The trusted source Artifact is named frontend-dispatch-verification-evidence-${run_id}.

The source contract is mad4b.frontend-dispatch-verification-evidence.v1 and declares consult_job_logs=false, direct_repository_mutation=false, protected_branch_mutation=false, force_push=false, and secrets_included=false.
Only committed_generated_parity is refresh-eligible; generation, contract, auth, or OpenAPI failures are never auto-repaired.
The dispatcher rejects main and Production, resolves exactly one same-repository pull request, verifies the source head and candidate, and passes expected_head_sha to the governed writer.
The repository-tool lifecycle regression accepts the read-only source workflow.
No runtime, provider, credential, migration, deployment, main, or Production mutation occurs in this journey.

phases.objective: Publish source-verification and delegated-refresh outcomes into the shared canonical pull-request evidence surface.
Exercise missing source artifacts, malformed identity, stale heads, ambiguous pull requests, removed labels, dispatch rejection, repeated workflow_run delivery, and writer compare-and-swap failure.
Observe one explicitly labeled non-production pull request move from committed parity failure to a governed exact-head refresh and passing verification.
This CI governance repair grants no deployment, migration, provider, credential, runtime, or Production authority.
